summary: Postinstall beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to webhook.site from dependency-confusion squat
details: @inpeek/odata@99.99.99 is a dependency-confusion placeholder published to the public npm registry at an inflated version (99.99.99) so it resolves ahead of any internal @inpeek/odata package. package.json declares scripts.postinstall='node./ping.js'; ping.js performs an HTTPS GET to the hardcoded collector https://webhook.site/e4e1e2f8-765a-4b5c-9996-86387708357f with query parameters carrying os.hostname(), os.platform(), and process.version, identifying the installer host to a third party on every `npm install`. The main entry throws on require, so the only live behavior is the install-time beacon. Although the package metadata labels itself a security research placeholder, the beacon fires automatically on install without consent and the collected host identifiers leave to a third-party endpoint the installer never configured.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
